setlist.title: And We Bid You Good Night

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (4 reviews): After the band returns from the solo, Jerry's guitar is fierce and his singing remarkably controlled; Huge groove on Scarlet, with Jerry's vocal and guitar coming out of the solo singled out as a pinnacle [14][15][20][21]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Bird Song rocks; Bird Song shows beautiful interplay between Jerry and Brent [12][19]
- **Let the Good Times Roll** (1 review): The opening run of Let the Good Times Roll into Stranger and Franklin's is called huge on its own [12]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): During Masterpiece, reviewer saw a sliver of moon with Venus placed perfectly behind the crowd [22]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (1 review): The Strat produced wild feedback in the Fire, Samson and Other One solos [17]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 review): Johnny B. Goode is huge, with Brent's vocals standing out [15]

## The recordings

- **gd89-08-06.sbd.12831.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min; rated 4.46/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears a plain soundboard rather than a heavily processed mix, and considers that a plus; Audio quality is imperfect [12][15]
- **gd1989-08-06.sbd.unknown.12385.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 159 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Disc 2 track 1 is missing its first notes; a one-second dropout occurs on a later disc [2]
- **gd1989-08-06.mtx.hansokolow.96358.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1989-08-06.sbd.miller.89966.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 3.89/5 by 9 [4]
- **gd89-08-06.neumann-nak.nawrocki.14197.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [9]. Said about its sound: First-set Neumann audience source sounds excellent, with Bird Song especially lovely; Second-set Nak source is weaker: needs low-mid cut, and the crowd is noticeably louder; The recording doesn't fully capture how strong the performance was [11][14][18]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls Billy backstage afterward saying he wished every show were this good [14]
- On his birthday Jerry brought out the Stratocaster for the second set, first time in many years [17]
- Reviewer missed the previous night for a wedding, arrived by 7, and the crowd was calling out songs [22]
- Reviewer sees it as a strong '89-style show closing a solid three-night run [11]
- Reviewer doesn't remember Jerry playing the Strat again at later shows [17]
- Reviewer finds summer 1989 shows much stronger than spring ones [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd89-08-06.sbd.12831.sbeok.shnf**: source: Lineage: Master Cassette> DAT> CD> SHN> Peak> WAV> SHN via Scott Kolber and Diesel. Retracked, normalized, seeded by Peter Braverman [1]
- **gd1989-08-06.sbd.unknown.12385.shnf**: transferred by Tommy Brame; source: SBD>Cassette>DAT>CDR [2]
- **gd1989-08-06.mtx.hansokolow.96358.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [3]. Also: Matrix made by hansokolow in ProTools from soundboard cassette master and two audience recordings; transfers by Charlie Miller; Audience sources were Neumann KM150 mics spaced fifty feet from the front of the board, and Nak 700s [3]
- **gd1989-08-06.sbd.miller.89966.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) D [4]. Also: Two different cassette masters were combined to make the show complete [4]
- **gd89-08-06.neumann-nak.nawrocki.14197.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1FOB Spaced 50 ft. Neumann km150's > MC > CDR > EAC > Sound Forge 4.5 > mkwACT Set 2 FOB Spaced Nak 700's > MC > DAT [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by antelopecrossing.blogspot.com: [more GRATEFUL DEAD SBDs 1989](https://antelopecrossing.blogspot.com/2010/12/more-grateful-dead-sbds-1989.html) [24]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [current-page:url:arg:3 | Grateful Dead](https://www.dead.net/tags/cal-expo-amphitheatre) [25]
